harm_cells_note: cells whose grade moved DOWN (consistent* away, related* down, inconsistent->mixed), cell-weighted, under the recorded declarations. The acceptance rule that decides this card is A1 (no dataset's consistent share falls); this column is reported whether or not it trips, and it is never omitted.

acceptance.rule: A1 (pre-registered): no dataset's cell-weighted `consistent` share may fall, under either declaration set; for an ACTIVATION the predecessor's PASS_ATTRIBUTED is not sufficient -- the verdict must be PASS.

in_sample_disclosure: IN-SAMPLE READING: the carrier was selected on the same volumes it is measured on, so this is a harm-line/regression reading of one measured drop and its repair. It is NOT a validation, NOT an independent test and NOT an accuracy claim; the carrier is a family-level (coarse) answer that clears the >=2 shared-gene bar only at the bar.
